messages:
ana: Postmortem follow-up: recurring pager noise from connection flaps on the redis tier. Need a concise action plan that reduces paging without hiding real outages.

pete: Yup, saw ~60 pages overnight at ~02:30, many identical across shards. Paging is burning people.

mika: Proposal: 1) add suppression window for non-prod shards (01:30-04:00 UTC) for p2s; 2) increase failure count threshold for p2 from 4->10; 3) dedupe key = shard + instance + err_code.

reza: Add a metric-level override: if overall error rate for redis_cluster > 150 errors/min then bypass suppression and page. Also include last-success annotation.

ana: Good. Can we also make dedupe window configurable per-cluster: prod 10m, staging 30m?

mika: yes. default 20m, prod shorter. I'll add flags.

ops-bot: Runbook updated by @ana -> https://redwood.internal/runbooks/redis-connection-flaps

pete: I sketched a rule: alert: RedisConnFlap expr: sum(rate(redis_conn_errors[1m])) by (shard) for: 2m labels: severity: p2 annotations: summary: "Redis connection flaps ({{shard}})". We'll add dedupe_label: "{{shard}}:{{instance}}:{{err_code}}"

reza: Timeline: PR by Wed EOD, staging deploy Thu morning, 48h monitor, prod Fri afternoon if green. Owners: pete (PR), ana (runbook + owners list), mika (dedupe + flags).

ana: I'll add a Grafana panel that shows alert counts by shard and dedupe closures. Helps verify reduction.

mika: Also plan to add an auto-close for suppressed duplicates after 25m so backlog doesn't grow.

ops-bot: @channel On-call this weekend -> Fri: @pete, Sat: @mika, Sun: @ana.

pete: action recap: pete -> PR for threshold + dedupe labels; ana -> runbook updates + owners; mika -> dedupe implementation + auto-close; reza -> add metric override test. Target: PR merged Wed EOD.

ana: thanks team. reconvene Mon 9am after staging validation to confirm noise reduction. :thumbsup:

mika: ACK, will post staging metrics in #eng-oncall when ready.
